lines.zh: 我踩着碎步，杖尖在地上拖。
lines.en: I take short steps, my staff dragging on the ground.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，袍子太长了。
lines.en: I do not walk fast; my robe is too long.

lines.zh: 我沿着平原边缘走过去。
lines.en: I walk along the edge of the plain.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边念着东西。
lines.en: I mutter something as I walk.
I pause half a step and go on.
I skirt the grass so I do not trip.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到能看见你的位置。
lines.en: I shift slowly to where I can see you.
My staff tests the way ahead.

lines.zh: 我走的时候帽尖一晃一晃。
lines.en: My hat tip bobs as I walk.
I shift a few steps your way.
I lift my hem a little.
I turn in place to another bearing.
I stand and the top of my staff glows.
I am chanting quietly.
The light atop my staff flickers.
I am watching the light on my staff.
Wind swells inside my robe.

lines.zh: 我把杖在地上顿了一下。
lines.en: I tap the staff once on the ground.
I count the steps you still owe me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地晃了一下手指。
lines.en: I wiggle a finger slowly.

lines.zh: 我身上有股烧纸的味道。
lines.en: I smell of burning paper.
I am working out the distance, carefully.

lines.zh: 你正好在我杖的射程内。
lines.en: You stand right in my staff's reach.
I raise my staff; you should step back.

lines.zh: 你这身护甲挡不住法术。
lines.en: That armour will not stop a spell.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，念得更快了。
lines.en: I look up at you and chant faster.

lines.zh: 你身上没有魔力的味道。
lines.en: You carry no smell of magic.

lines.zh: 像你这样拿剑的我见得多。
lines.en: I have seen many sword-bearers like you.
Do not move; I will aim better.
My staff points at you.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就念快一点。
lines.en: You step back and I chant faster.
You are dead centre of my line.
My chanting breaks.
I step back and hold the staff.
A tear opens in my robe.
Gritting my teeth, I resume the spell.
My hat is askew and I ignore it.
That broke my spell apart.
I bring my staff across my chest.
The staff's glow dims for an instant.
A decent interruption.
I retreat and recalculate the range.
I want what you carry.
That weapon will do you no good.
Leave the thing and you may go.
That glow of yours interferes with me.
Standing there, you make a fine target.

lines.zh: 你手里的宝石，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the gem in your hand.
The more you retreat, the harder my chant.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我反而看得清。
lines.en: Raise your torch; I see you better.

lines.zh: 你的同伴要来，我也不怕。
lines.en: Bring your companions; I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢掉，省我一发。
lines.en: Drop it and save me a shot.
You bump me and my staff tilts.
I step back and my robe snags.
I brace on my staff and steady.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，我的帽子掉了。
lines.en: We collide and my hat falls.

lines.zh: 我被推得一歪，又正回来。
lines.en: Pushed askew, I right myself.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，闻到一股烟味。
lines.en: You hit me and catch a smell of smoke.
I flick my hand and my sleeve brushes you.

lines.zh: 分开后，我立刻把杖举起来。
lines.en: After we part, I lift my staff at once.

lines.zh: 我被撞得退了半步，念错了。
lines.en: Knocked back half a step, I lose the chant.
I hold you off at staff's length.
I care only for incantations.
That is of no use.
Hold a staff steady first.

lines.zh: 我没时间应付这种问题。
lines.en: I have no time for such questions.
I shake my head and keep chanting.
That is not a clever question.
I plant the staff in the soil.
We do not speak of this.
I point into the distance.
Do not make me lose the end of this incantation.
I flick it up with my staff's tip.
I pick it up and tuck it in my robe.
This thing has a little magic in it.
I hold it and chant a line.
I gather what falls in passing.
I cannot grip it; I wrap it in my sleeve.
Too small to be worth it.
My hat already holds three pieces.
I pick it up and drop it again.
I will keep this for a reagent.
I point my staff tip at you.
I raise my staff, aimed your way.
The distance is right for a full chant.
I light the tip of my staff.
My staff tip frames you dead center.

lines.zh: 这个目标我留着慢慢打。
lines.en: I will take my time with this one.
Wherever you are, my staff tip points.
I begin the spell toward you.
You are where this shot will land.

lines.zh: 我另一只手也举到胸前。
lines.en: My other hand rises to my chest too.
Once locked, I do not move.

lines.zh: 目标就是这个站在平原上的。
lines.en: The target is the one standing on the plain.
I whisper a single syllable.

lines.zh: 你身上的护甲我算过了。
lines.en: I have calculated your armour.
I turn my hat brim toward you.
I have already measured your escape route.
I settle my weight and stand firm.
I raise the staff; here comes the first.
I keep aimed at you, unswerving.
You move, and my staff follows.
Standing here is enough.
My chant has not broken.

lines.zh: 你绕到石头后，我抬高一点。
lines.en: You go behind a rock and I aim higher.

lines.zh: 我不追，我等你自己露头。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for you to show.
The further you retreat, the calmer I am.

lines.zh: 我把杖在地上画了个圈。
lines.en: I draw a circle on the ground with my staff.

lines.zh: 你听见那种嗡嗡声了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear that droning?

lines.zh: 你在我的节拍里，逃不掉。
lines.en: You are inside my rhythm; you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 我念完这一段，你就完了。
lines.en: When this passage ends, so do you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，算你走位。
lines.en: I watch your feet to read your movement.

lines.zh: 我一边念一边朝你侧移。
lines.en: I chant while sidestepping toward you.

lines.zh: 你把头低下，我就打不到？
lines.en: Duck and you think I cannot hit you?
I raise the staff and aim upward.
You walk further, and the spell still follows.

lines.zh: 我把重心稳在两脚之间。
lines.en: I settle my weight between both feet.
I will not let you down this path.

lines.zh: 你看我的杖，别看我的脸。
lines.en: Watch my staff, not my face.
I wait for the chant to come full circle.

lines.zh: 我杖尖一送，光打在你身上。
lines.en: I thrust my staff and light strikes you.
This shot comes straight at you.
I raise the staff and light shoots from its tip.
That blast put you a step back.
My staff raps your shoulder.
I sent this one low.

lines.zh: 光擦过你的护甲，冒烟了。
lines.en: The light grazes your armour and it smokes.
I loose two in a row.

lines.zh: 你挡了第一下，第二下没挡住。
lines.en: You blocked the first, not the second.
I chant faster and my breath wavers.

lines.zh: 这一下让地面焦了一块。
lines.en: That scorched a patch of ground.
I step back and raise the staff again.
Light gathers in my palm.

lines.zh: 这一发不太准，可还是打到了。
lines.en: Not accurate, and it still landed.
This one comes on a slant from the side.

lines.zh: 我把杖横过来，挡了一下。
lines.en: I turn my staff sideways and block.
The light bursts a small patch of ground.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡脸，我从下打腿。
lines.en: You shield your face; I strike low at your legs.
This shot follows the last.
I chant slowly, for accuracy.
A point of light rises on the plain.

lines.zh: 我先念了一句，然后现身。
lines.en: I speak a line first, then appear.
The staff's glow sways in the grass.

lines.zh: 我从远处的烟里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the distant smoke.
You hear a low chanting.

lines.zh: 我站在平原中间，袍子垂着。
lines.en: I stand mid-plain, robe hanging.

lines.zh: 我把杖插进土里，站直了。
lines.en: I plant the staff and straighten.

lines.zh: 风把草压低，我就在那里。
lines.en: The wind flattens the grass, and there I am.
I draw my hands from my robe.

lines.zh: 这一带的光线偏了一点。
lines.en: The light here shifts a little.
I raise my eyes under the hat.
I step out of the grass.

lines.zh: 火烧到袍子，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my robe and I swat it.
I fall down the slope and my staff rolls away.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我念不下去了。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and the chant dies.
The blast knocks my staff askew.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的袍子，我转了个圈。
lines.en: An arrow through my robe spins me around.

lines.zh: 对方的法术压过我，我哑了一下。
lines.en: Their magic overpowers mine and I go mute.

lines.zh: 念咒太耗力气，我站不稳了。
lines.en: Chanting drains me, and I cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的杖亮得刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my staff glares.

lines.zh: 虚空吸我，咒文散在空中。
lines.en: The void pulls and my words scatter in air.
